description: Usi del mare (In_Sea) - Regolamentazione del traffico marittimo: Schema di separazione del traffico e aree regolamentate Porto di Ravenna - ORD.32/2022 is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Emilia Romagna. Nella zona di mare antistante l'imboccatura del porto di Ravenna è istituito lo schema di separazione del traffico navale (Traffic Separation Scheme), nel quale sono individuate aree sottoposte a particolari vincoli/divieti secondo l'Ordinanza 32/2022 emanata dal Ministero delle Infrastrutture e della mobilità sostenibili - Capitaneria di Porto di Ravenna. Coverage: Regione Emilia Romagna. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Emilia Romagna. Its tags are aree-costiere-marine, eu, open-data, opera-portuale, ravenna. It offers 4 resource(s) in DOC, HTML, MAP_SRVC, XML. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
